trossets.name: Trossets
trossets.line: Long-form generative algorithm: twelve construction blocks, endless multiscale Truchet patterns.
exhibitions: 2022 — NFT Barcelona, Real Cercle Artístic, Barcelona
2022 — Decentral Art Pavilion, Biennale di Venezia, Venice
geek: A multiscale Truchet pattern, after Carlson’s multiscale tiles (2018), reduced to 13 building blocks. No rotation and no colour alternation: the algorithm only chooses which block goes in each cell.

The grid is 6×3, 9×5 or 12×7, and it is subdivided only once. Most outputs have large tiles and about 8% small ones; 12% of the 12×7 outputs have many small tiles and few large ones. Where the two sizes overlap, shapes step on each other and draw “beautiful errors” that are not in the code.
Which blocks appear is weighted randomness: of the 1,000 outputs, 15 use only vertical blocks, 14 only horizontal ones and 43 use all 13. The rarest composition, vertical, is #931.
Colour: 18 named palettes (Paella, Tortilla, Olivos, Palamós, Buganvilea…), chosen by eye and named afterwards, when they turned out to evoke places.
From the PhD thesis, §2.2.3. Provisional summary, to be checked by Anna.
